description.value: Dayton Audio’s ground breaking Epique E180HE-PR 7” with a carbon fiber cone is the perfect companion for the Epique Series MMAG while retaining the same family look. It was engineered for a low FS in order to replace the excessive port lengths required for low-tuned enclosures. The E180HE-PR passive radiator gives you the opportunity to create systems that provide extraordinary accuracy and fidelity, without the extraordinary size.Product HighlightsPassive radiators for the exceptional Epique Series enables you to use smaller boxes by replacing ports with excessive lengthsCarbon fiber cone is strong enough to handle the pressure of high output driversIncredibly linear 19mm xmech enhances output at low tuningsIncredible versatility, perfect compliment for any compact subwooferCosmetically identical to the Epique MMAG subwoofersProduct Manuals / Spec Sheets / DownloadsEpique E180HE-PR Specification SheetEpique E180HE-PR Mechanical DrawingBuying OptionsBuy on Parts ExpressBuy Internationally
